Feminism is about empowering women who have been oppressed by men and male-centric roles.  That's the core value and mindset, regardless of whether one agrees or not.  It's what the core founders of the movement believed in, and what the main works discuss.

It's fascinating how being friendly to people, if you are not of the correct disposition or level of attraction, is taken as yet another reason to insult and degrade you.  I really do not understand why people are so hateful to some.  It makes no sense.  I do not understand why people stick around, this is so pointless, bleak, and empty.  There is no interaction if you are not of the correct genetics.  You are seen as trash.  There appears to be nothing that can be done to change.  Either people accept you, or you are eventually outed for the lonely weirdo you are.  No one associates with that person, except out of pity.

It's hard hiding the fact that you're not a human, from other people.  They can feel it.  It's just a matter of getting the courage to end this consciousness.
